 The car is becoming a computer on wheels, and AI is moving from the cloud to the edge; right onto silicon. Our S32N automotive MPUs pack proprietary AI IP blocks that let carmakers run machine learning where it matters: in the vehicle, in real-time, safely.

 Solid software fundamentals (C/C++ a plus), version control (git), and curiosity about how software meets hardware.
 A builder's mindset: you learn by doing, you're not afraid of the unknown, and you like solving problems that don't have a textbook answer.
 Great communication, because you'll be explaining clever things to smart people, including customers.
 Nice to have (but we'll teach you):
 Embedded systems, edge AI deployment, automotive/functional-safety awareness, model quantisation and optimisation.
 Why this role is different:
 You're joining at the ground floor of edge AI in automotive, with real silicon, real customers, and the freedom to shape a brand-new capability inside our team. You'll be surrounded by a global network of experienced engineers to learn from, while bringing skills we need and don't yet have. Come help us lead the industry instead of following it.

gehc:MR-Research-Scientist_R4040298-1.desc:
Job Description Summary 
You will work within an interdisciplinary team to innovate and push the technical envelope in all aspects of magnetic resonance imaging. You will have opportunities to work both on MRI systems hardware as well as algorithms and pulse sequence development. The research and development work will be across 1.5T-3.0T whole body and 3.0T-7.0T high-performance, head-only MRI platforms. 
 Job Description 
 Job Description

 Apply deep knowledge in MR physics, mathematics, engineering and chemistry to conceptualize and […] Qualifications 
 Ph.D. degree in Physics, Electrical Engineering, Biomedical Engineering, Chemistry, Computer Engineering, or other related fields, with at least 3 years of research experience.
 A demonstrated record of research and development outcomes as evidenced by peer-reviewed conference proceedings and journal publications.
 Strong fundamentals in MR imaging physics and sub-systems, signal processing and electromagnetic theory.
 Demonstrated strong problem-solving skills, including the ability to understand and address root causes of MR image quality issues in investigational prototypes.
 Proficiency in programming in C, Python and/ or simulation tools.
 Legal authorization to work in the U.S. is required. You will need to have valid, on-going authorization to work in the U.S.
 Must be willing to work out of an office located in Niskayuna, NY.
 You must submit your application for employment on the careers page at https://careers.gehealthcare.com to be considered.
 Desired Characteristics 
 Demonstrated ability to originate and follow through on ideas.
 High levels of curiosity, independence and adaptability.
 Strong interpersonal skills.
 Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
 Experience in writing and executing grant proposals.

bfl:e7935ad1-7b9a-4c85-8b40-09cafedf7d63.desc:
ABOUT BLACK FOREST LABS

We're the team behind Latent Diffusion, Stable Diffusion, and FLUX — foundational technologies that changed how the world creates images and videos. Our FLUX models are among the most advanced in the world, and we're just getting started.

Headquartered in Freiburg, Germany with a growing presence in San Francisco, we're scaling fast while staying true to what makes us different: research excellence, open science, and building technology that expands human creativity.




WHY THIS ROLE

Frontier image and video models are now good enough that the hard question is no […] WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

You have made meaningful contributions to the evaluation of generative models already. You understand that a benchmark figure without careful consideration of sample size and judge agreement with humans is at best uninformed optimism and at worst dangerously misleading, and you have been the person that found that inconvenient regression that nobody wanted to talk about.

You likely have:

 - Advanced degree (MS/PhD) in a relevant field or demonstrated equivalent practical experience

 - Practical experience with evaluating generative models, in a hands-on way. You may have worked with diffusion or flow-matching based image or video models already, but the capability to evaluate them in earnest transfers to other modalities too

 - Very strong Python and software engineering skills, with pipelines that run reliably and that other people can read if needed

 - Working knowledge of PyTorch and modern ML infrastructure and practices; you are not a pure Python developer, you know what the modern ML code looks like

 - Strong grasp of statistics and its shortcomings in practice, and how to work with those; sample sizes, inter-annotator agreement, confidence levels, etc., and a healthy skepticism about what those numbers say about the world

 - Practical experience with building and operating LLM-as-judge systems, and understanding their limitations

 - …

hn:49935497.desc:
Prior Labs | Berlin, Freiburg, NYC | ONSITE | Full-time | Technical PM, ML Infra, Research Scientist/Engineer, Backend, Full Stack
We build foundation models for tabular data. Deep learning transformed text and images but mostly skipped tables, which are still the data behind most clinical trials, financial models and scientific experiments. The reason is structural: no natural sequence, no spatial structure, no shared vocabulary across datasets, so the architectures and scaling laws behind LLMs don't transfer.
Our approach: pre-train a transformer on millions of synthetic datasets sampled […] m causal-structure priors. The whole dataset goes in as context, predictions come out in one forward pass. No per-dataset training, no hyperparameter tuning, seconds instead of hours. TabPFN v2 was published in Nature and set a new state of the art; TabPFN-3 scales to 10M rows. 4M+ downloads, 8k+ GitHub stars, in production from liquid biopsy to rail maintenance. Code: https://github.com/PriorLabs/TabPFN 
Since July we're an independent lab inside SAP, with more than EUR 1B committed over four years. Models stay open, research stays public, same team and offices.
Roles (most can sit in any of the three offices):
- Technical Product Manager, Integrations: take every model release live across SAP (AI Core to SAP Analytics Cloud), the cloud marketplaces and customer environments, and help decide which channels we build next. Reports to me, close to the code.
- ML Engineer, Infrastructure: own multi-cluster GPU infra (Slurm on GCP today, multi-provider next), training performance and the tooling layer. We spend tens of millions per year on compute; you own that budget.
- Research Scientist, Foundation Model: drive the model agenda - novel architectures, scaling from 10K to 1M+ samples, multimodal and causal directions. PhD plus top-venue publications, or equivalent.

 L'IA transforme déjà le fonctionnement des entreprises. Chez Modjo, nous voulons révolutionner la manière dont les équipes commerciales vendent.

wttj:dfe3fe15-ad37-4d9d-99dd-640f9820cf2.desc:
Buscamos desarrolladores y desarrolladoras de soluciones de inteligencia artificial para asumir alguno de los proyectos que ya tenemos en marcha en el país. Según el proyecto, también te encargarás de la parte Full Stack de tu proyecto, así que combinarás IA con desarrollo end-to-end. Además, tendrás la oportunidad de ir asumiendo mayor liderazgo técnico a medida que crezca el equipo.
 Tu progresión en Galadrim 
 En 3 meses: Habrás trabajado en tus 2 primeros proyectos de IA. En Galadrim creemos en el learning by doing, así que trabajarás rápidamente en proyectos reales para nuestros […]  contando con el apoyo de un mentor técnico que realizará contigo sesiones de pair-programming y code reviews . También podrás participar en conferencias y workshops internacionales con el resto del equipo.
 En 6 meses: Ya dominarás nuestro stack y metodología, y podrás asumir más responsabilidades ayudándonos a estructurar el equipo (selección, gestión, desarrollo de herramientas internas, etc.). Para que te hagas una idea: en nuestra oficina de París pasamos de 2 a más de 20 ingenieros en menos de 3 años.
 A largo plazo: Podrás implicarte directamente en el crecimiento de nuestra actividad en España.
 Ejemplos de proyectos 
 Te involucrarás en una gran variedad de proyectos en múltiples sectores:
 Desarrollo de asistentes de voz en el sector médico.
 Entrenamiento y despliegue de modelos de visión en sistemas embebidos.
 Industrialización y automatización de retoques fotográficos.
 Uso de LLM para la generación automática de fichas de producto.
 Modelización de previsión de la demanda en la industria.
 Stack técnico principal 
 No te preocupes si no dominas todas estas tecnologías, el stack depende del proyecto. Aquí tienes nuestro stack más utilizado, pero se adaptará según tu nivel y las necesidades del proyecto:
 Python, PyTorch, Hugging Face
 API de OpenAI / VertexAI / Anthropic / etc.
 YOLO (You only look once) - Computer Vision
 PostgreSQL
 Node.js (Adonis, Nest.js)
 …

Como ingeniero/a de IA autónomo/a , tu misión consistirá en desarrollar soluciones de inteligencia artificial que aporten el máximo valor posible a tus clientes y a sus usuarios.
 Tus tareas
 Implementar modelos de IA con un enfoque pragmático e iterativo, recurriendo, cuando sea necesario, a modelos preentrenados o a servicios especializados;
 Desarrollar funcionalidades en modo full-stack para integrar la IA en los productos y servicios del cliente, dando prioridad a la mejora continua;
 Recopilar, depurar y preparar los datos para el entrenamiento de los modelos, adoptando un enfoque […] tico para maximizar la eficacia;
 Evaluar y mejorar el rendimiento de los modelos de IA utilizando técnicas de evaluación adecuadas , con el objetivo de obtener resultados significativos;
 Contribuir a las decisiones estructurales del proyecto desde el punto de vista de los modelos y la infraestructura técnica.
 Ejemplos de proyectos 
 Participarás en una variedad de proyectos apasionantes y diversos , que abarcan numerosos sectores de actividad:
 Desarrollo de asistentes de voz en el sector médico
 Entrenamiento e implementación de modelos de visión artificial en sistemas integrados
 Industrialización y automatización de retoques fotográficos
 Uso de modelos de lenguaje a gran escala (LLM) para la generación automática de fichas de productos
 Modelización de la previsión de la demanda en la industria
 Stack técnico principal 
 Exploramos continuamente las nuevas tecnologías y los últimos avances en IA (modelos de difusión, LLM, etc.). Para el desarrollo de IA, nuestras tecnologías preferidas son Python, PyTorch, Hugging Face y las API de OpenAI o equivalentes. Para la programación full-stack, utilizamos TypeScript, Node.js, React y las bases de datos MySQL/PostgreSQL.

linkedin:4456312377.desc: Bei NEURA Robotics führen kognitive Roboter nicht einfach Befehle aus. Sie nehmen ihre Umgebung wahr, ziehen Schlüsse daraus, planen über lange Zeithorizonte und handeln autonom in der physischen Welt. Unsere Robotic Foundation Models übernehmen die physische Ausführung. Darüber sitzt der Agent: die Instanz, die erarbeitet, was eine Aufgabe tatsächlich erfordert, sie in Schritte zerlegt, die der Roboter ausführen kann, und erkennt, wann die Realität nicht mehr zum Plan passt. Für den Aufbau dieser Agents auf unserer Humanoid-Plattform suchen wir dich. Deine Mission & Herausforderungen […]  Agent Harness: Du entwickelst den Agent, der auf unserer Humanoid-Plattform läuft — den Loop von Sensorinput über Reasoning bis zur Aktion, seine Interfaces zu Kameras, Tiefendaten und Propriozeption des Roboters sowie das State Management, das eine Aufgabe über Minuten statt Sekunden hinweg kohärent hält. Task Decomposition & Long-Horizon Planning: Du übersetzt übergeordnete menschliche Intention in geordnete, ausführbare Schritte — jeweils mit den nötigen Preconditions, räumlichen Referenzen und Success Criteria — und sequenzierst sie so, dass der Roboter eine Aufgabe bewältigt, die er in dieser exakten Form noch nie gesehen hat. Visual Reasoning & World State: Du nutzt VLMs, um zu interpretieren, was der Roboter sieht, verankerst Sprache in der Szene (Grounding) und pflegst eine Arbeitsrepräsentation von Objekten, Affordances und Task History, über die der Planner schlussfolgern kann. Closed-Loop Execution & Recovery: Du verifizierst jeden Schritt gegen die Beobachtung, statt Erfolg anzunehmen, erkennst Abweichungen vom Plan und planst neu, wiederholst oder eskalierst an einen Menschen, wenn das Risiko zu hoch ist. Evaluation auf dem Roboter: Du misst Task Success in der Simulation und auf echter Hardware, baust Failure Taxonomies aus realen Runs auf und entscheidest darauf basierend, ob ein Fix in den Planner, das Interface oder den ausgegebenen Schritt gehört. …

About the Team

OpenAI’s Applied AI Engineering team helps organizations turn frontier AI capabilities into safe, reliable, and high-impact production systems. We work with customer executives, product and engineering teams, security leaders, and transformation teams to identify valuable opportunities, accelerate technical implementation, and scale what works.

Production-ready deployments are defined by complexity rather than any one industry: existing architectures, diverse data environments, security and governance requirements, multiple stakeholder groups, and organization-wide change. About the Role

As an Applied AI Engineer you will partner directly with leading organizations to design, build, and deploy AI systems that deliver measurable business outcomes. You will combine deep technical judgment, hands-on engineering, and customer leadership to take ambitious ideas from use-case selection and architecture through prototyping, evaluation, production launch, and scale.

You will write and debug code, build evaluation systems, resolve complex integrations, and guide decisions involving model behavior, reliability, latency, cost, safety, security, governance, and operational readiness. Success is measured by production systems, sustained adoption, and meaningful customer impact—not simply activity or successful demonstrations.

This is a rare opportunity to work on consequential real-world deployments at the frontier of AI while directly influencing how OpenAI’s products evolve.

This role is based in Munich. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees

Rattachée au Ministre des armées, l’AMIAD est une entité en en forte croissance qui développe et déploie des solutions d’IA au profit des armées. En lien étroit avec l’ensemble des entités […]  ministère, elle pilote des projets stratégiques et innovants dans des domaines variés tels que les systèmes d’armes, les opérations, le renseignement, le commandement, le soutien et l’administration. Descriptif du poste Ce stage porte sur la navigation autonome de robots terrestres en milieu tout-terrain. Les politiques de navigation apprises, comme NoMaD ou les modèles de l'AMIAD, génèrent des trajectoires réactives à court terme à partir d'images ou de LiDAR. Leur horizon temporel et sémantique reste toutefois limité : elles décident mal de la marche à suivre, s'adaptent peu au type de terrain et savent difficilement détecter qu'elles sont bloquées ou récupérer d'un échec. Les piles de navigation classiques confient cette supervision à des arbres de comportement (Nav2 sous ROS2), mais ceux-ci reposent sur des règles fixes, difficiles à étendre à des missions ouvertes en langage naturel. Le stage explore le paradigme du « VLA comme orchestrateur », développé en manipulation robotique : un modèle vision-langage de haut niveau supervise une politique bas niveau figée. Le stagiaire devra concevoir l'architecture de cet orchestrateur, développer l'adaptation des paramètres (vitesse, horizon de planification) au terrain perçu, mettre en place la détection d'échecs et des comportements de récupération, puis évaluer l'ensemble en simulation face à un arbre de comportement de type …

Who are we?

Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company.  We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems.

We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that.

We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is […] Qualifications

 - Strong research and software engineering skills, with hands-on experience training LLMs.

 - Experience applying reinforcement learning to LLMs (e.g., PPO, GRPO, RLHF, RLVR), ideally at scale.

 - Track record of work on generalization, robustness, or distribution shift, through publications or shipped models.

 - Rigorous experimental practice: clean ablations, careful controls, and sound conclusions from noisy results.

 - Experience with distributed training (e.g., JAX, PyTorch, FSDP, Megatron) is a plus.

 - Excellent communication skills.

 - Deep understanding of data quality principles and best practices: demonstrates willingness to dive deep into data while possessing strong intuition for assessing the quality of datasets and anticipating how different data characteristics will impact model training outcomes.
   

Working Location
This role can be based remotely or from one of our office locations listed on the job description - there is no minimum in-office qualification requirement. We care most about hiring exceptional people regardless of locations, though please check the location listed on the posting for guidance around the core time zone or working hours alignment expected for the role.

Join our Team
 Shape the future of sensing and wireless communication 
 What if the next generation of mobile networks could do more than connect people and devices? What if they could also sense, interpret, and understand the world around them?
At Ericsson, we are turning that vision into reality through Integrated Sensing and Communication (ISAC) research. Join us as a researcher and help develop the sensing and tracking technologies that will influence future 5G and 6G radio networks.
 About the Opportunity

• Practical experience working with environmental clutter, with hands-on knowledge of sea clutter considered essential.
• Working knowledge of data fusion and end-to-end tracking pipelines.
• Experience developing and evaluating both point-object and extended-object tracking algorithms.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to connect theoretical research to practical prototypes and product solutions.
• A passion for innovation, curiosity to explore new approaches, and the confidence to turn ideas into demonstrable results.
• Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the personal drive to challenge ideas respectfully, work across diverse teams, and deliver results.

Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance 
 At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

 Tether Education : Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.
 Tether Evolution : At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.
 Why Join Us? 
 As an AI Harness Engineer, you’re not just building integrations for AI —you’re developing new and innovative ways to connect people to local AI, and how that AI will become a fixture in our lives. You will push QVAC to new levels, using P2P technology to enable limitless scale, making you essential to the company’s …

linkedin:4456319283.title: AI Engineer - Task Planning and Orchestration, Embodied Agents (human)
linkedin:4456319283.desc: At NEURA Robotics, cognitive robots don't just execute commands. They perceive, reason, plan over long horizons, and act autonomously in the physical world. Our robotic foundation models handle the physical execution. What sits above them is the agent: the part that works out what a task actually requires, breaks it into steps the robot can carry out, and notices when reality has stopped matching the plan. We're looking for an engineer to help build those agents for our humanoid platform. Your Mission & Challenges Embodied agent harness: Design and build the agent that runs on our humanoid […] tform — the loop from sensor input to reasoning to action, its interfaces to the robot's cameras, depth, and proprioception, and the state management that keeps a task coherent over minutes rather than seconds. Task decomposition & long-horizon planning: Turn high-level human intent into ordered, executable steps, each with the preconditions, spatial references, and success criteria it needs, and sequence them so the robot can work through a task it has never seen in that exact form before. Visual reasoning & world state: Use VLMs to interpret what the robot is looking at, ground language in the scene, and maintain a working representation of objects, affordances, and task history for the planner to reason over. Closed-loop execution & recovery: Verify each step against observation instead of assuming success, detect divergence from the plan, and replan, retry, or escalate to a human when the risk is too high. Evaluation on the robot: Measure task success in simulation and on real hardware, build failure taxonomies from real runs, and use them to decide whether a fix belongs in the planner, the interface, or the step being issued. Cross-functional collaboration: Work closely with our foundation model, perception, manipulation, and hardware teams to take the reasoning layer above the models from concept to reliable behavior on a deployed robot. linkedin:4479246847.title: Caractérisation d'écoulements diphasiques par couplage Flot Optique et IA. F/H
linkedin:4479246847.desc: Chez EDF, la maîtrise des écoulements diphasiques (air/eau) est un enjeu clé, que ce soit pour les évacuateurs de crue des barrages hydrauliques ou dans les circuits de centrales nucléaires. Pour analyser ces phénomènes complexes, nous disposons de données expérimentales (caméras rapides, sondes laser) et d'une méthodologie d'analyse d'images combinant deux approches, présentées sur la Figure 1 : Segmentation par IA (Figure 1b) avec le modèle SAM2 (Segment Anything Model 2) pour détecter et cartographier les bulles (taille, forme, trajectoire). Le Flot Optique (Figure 1c) pour estimer les champs de vitesse globaux de l'écoulement. L'objectif de ce stage est de consolider la chaîne d'analyse pour en faire un outil robuste et validé. Les missions principales s'articuleront autour des axes suivants : Validation quantitative du Flot Optique : Confronter le flot optique aux mesures de référence ("vérité terrain") obtenues par sondes optiques afin de quantifier les incertitudes de la méthode. Automatisation de la brique IA : Développer une méthode de classification pour rendre la segmentation par IA entièrement automatique et scalable. Analyse physique étendue : Exploiter la chaîne validée pour quantifiée les phénnomènes physiques (vitesse, fragmentation …) et alimenter la modélisation. Ces axes constituent une base qui sera co-construite avec le ou la stagiaire pour valoriser son profil et ses appétences. Étudiante ou étudiant avec de solides compétences et/ou une forte appétence pour la mécanique des fluides, le traitement d’images et les sciences des données/IA. La maîtrise d'au moins deux de ces domaines est un atout majeur. Rigueur et éthique scientifique doublée d’un goût pour la recherche appliquée. Date de début : entre janvier et mars 2027 Durée du stage : 5 à 6 mois Localisation : EDF Lab Chatou, 78400, (RER A)

thales:Ingnieur-e--Dveloppement-Radar---.desc:
Lieu : Limours, France 
 Construisons ensemble un avenir de confiance 
 Thales est un leader mondial des hautes technologies spécialisé dans trois secteurs d’activité : Défense & Sécurité, Aéronautique & Spatial, et Cyber & Digital. Il développe des produits et solutions qui contribuent à un monde plus sûr, plus respectueux de l’environnement et plus inclusif. Le Groupe investit près de 4,5 milliards d’euros par an en Recherche & Développement, notamment dans des domaines clés de l’innovation tels que l’IA, la cybersécurité, le quantique, les technologies du cloud et la 6G. Thales compte près […] Votre profil
 Vous disposez d’un BAC +5 et avez de l'expérience sur :
 L’ingénierie système appliquée à un projet complexe
 Le développement d'outils et d'algorithmes en traitement du signal et en traitement de données
 Mathématique appliquée : traitement du signal, traitement de données, statistiques, algorithmes d'optimisation
 Simulation et modélisation : conception, intégration, tests et évaluation de performances
 Maîtrise de MATLAB ou équivalent
 C’est un plus si vous avez :
 Des connaissances dans les traitements radar
 Des compétences en développement logiciel et intelligence artificielle
 Des compétences en ingénierie système et IVVQ : approche MBSE, conception et analyse de système, formalisation des exigences
 Goût pour le travail en environnement multidisciplinaire, autonomie, rigueur, qualités relationnelles, sens de la communication, apte à confronter les idées et/ou partager les difficultés, sont des atouts que l'on vous reconnait ?
 Alors ce poste est fait pour vous !
Thales, entreprise Handi-Engagée, reconnait tous les talents. La diversité est notre meilleur atout. Postulez et rejoignez nous ! 
Le poste pouvant nécessiter d'accéder à des informations relevant du secret de la défense nationale, la personne retenue fera l'objet d'une procédure d’habilitation, conformément aux dispositions des articles R.2311-1 et suivants du Code de la défense et de l’IGI 1300 …

tether:2785199.title: Fullstack Engineer - AgenticOps (100% Remote)
tether:2785199.desc:
Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance 
 At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.
 Innovate with […] you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.
 Are you ready to be part of the future? 
 About the job 
 We are looking for Fullstack Engineer to help QVAC application teams develop, review, test, and deliver reliable software with less friction. Your focus will be our desktop and mobile applications and their shared runtime, AI harness, and skills packages. You will build and maintain developer tools, integrate AI agents into engineering workflows, and improve code quality and delivery automation. 
 This is a hands-on engineering role with room to shape the tooling roadmap. You will work with engineers to identify useful improvements and own them from implementation through adoption and ongoing support. Success means shorter feedback loops, dependable automation, and tools that developers trust and use. 
 Responsibilities 
 Evaluate, integrate, and maintain developer tools and AI agents, including the repository guidance and integrations they need to work effectively. 
 Build and operate agents in CI and scheduled workflows that investigate failures, propose fixes, and give engineers evidence they can act on. 
 Improve automated pull request reviews, evaluating finding accuracy and reducing noise for reviewers. 
 Develop code quality scripts and checks for complexity, …

geaerospace:Menederka-Meneder-ds-strateg.desc:
Job Description Summary 
 Job Description 
 Menedżerka/Menedżer ds. strategii AI 
Miejsce pracy: Bank BPH, Gdańsk/Warszawa 
 Forma zatrudnienia: umowa o pracę 
 Wymiar czasu pracy: pełny etat 
 W Banku BPH rozpoczynamy program rozwoju i wdrażania rozwiązań opartych na sztucznej inteligencji (AI). Naszym celem jest wykorzystanie nowoczesnych technologii do zwiększania efektywności operacyjnej, automatyzacji procesów oraz tworzenia nowych możliwości wspierających realizację celów biznesowych banku.
 Poszukujemy osoby, która odegra kluczową rolę w budowaniu kompetencji AI w organizacji – od […] tworzenia strategii i architektury rozwiązań, przez organizację bezpiecznego środowiska eksperymentowania, aż po wdrażanie rozwiązań przynoszących mierzalne korzyści biznesowe.
 Stanowisko łączy kompetencje architekta rozwiązań AI oraz koordynatora inicjatyw realizowanych we współpracy z jednostkami biznesowymi, IT, funkcjami kontrolnymi i strukturami korporacyjnymi.
 Osoba zatrudniona na tym stanowisku będzie raportować bezpośrednio do Dyrektora IT i będzie miała realny wpływ na kształtowanie sposobu wykorzystania AI w banku.
 Kogo szukamy? 
 Szukamy osoby, która nie tylko zna technologie AI, ale przede wszystkim potrafi wykorzystać je do rozwiązywania rzeczywistych problemów biznesowych.
Rozumiejącej, że skuteczne wdrożenie AI wymaga połączenia technologii, bezpieczeństwa, zgodności regulacyjnej i współpracy z biznesem.
 Twój zakres odpowiedzialności 
 Strategia i rozwój AI 
 Udział w opracowaniu i realizacji strategii AI banku, we współpracy z partnerami doradczymi, biznesem i IT.
 Przekładanie strategii AI na konkretne inicjatywy, rozwiązania technologiczne i plan wdrożeń.
 Identyfikowanie możliwości wykorzystania AI do automatyzacji i optymalizacji procesów bankowych.
 Monitorowanie rozwoju technologii AI oraz rekomendowanie rozwiązań odpowiadających potrzebom banku.
 Architektura i technologia 
 Projektowanie i rozwijanie architektury rozwiązań AI
 Koordynowanie budowy i …

linkedin:4477033229.desc: Die Sektion für Klinische Forschungs-IT (SKFIT) wird am UKSH Campus Lübeck eine eigene Plattform für ML-getriebene klinische Entscheidungsunterstützung aufbauen – von der Forschung bis in die Versorgung. Dafür suchen wir eine (Medizin-)Informatikerin/einen (Medizin-)Informatiker im Bereich der KI/ML-getriebenen Datenanalyse für klinische Entscheidungsunterstützungssysteme. Warum diese Stelle besonders ist Als Teil des UKSH dürfen wir Patientendaten inhouse analysieren und eigene klinische Entscheidungsunterstützungssysteme (CDSS) nicht nur erforschen, sondern nach 6 GDNG und Art. 5 Abs. 5 MDR […] (VO (EU) 2017/745) auch vereinfacht in die Versorgung überführen. linkedin:4479894269.desc: Word de beste versie van jezelf als AI Engineer Net afgestudeerd en klaar om écht iets met AI te doen? Heb je al wat ervaring met Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning of Generative AI en wil je je verder ontwikkelen tot een echte AI-expert? Dan is het Young Professional Track AI Engineering bij Sogeti jouw kans om impact te maken. In deze periode leer je hoe je AI slim inzet om organisaties te helpen vernieuwen en verbeteren. Je werkt met moderne technologieën, behaalt relevante certificeringen en doet ervaring op bij klanten. Jouw start bij Sogeti Je begint met een traject waarin je […] skills ontwikkelt zoals samenwerken, communiceren en persoonlijk leiderschap. Een periode vol groei en verbinding. Daarna start je met een inhoudelijke opleiding waarin je jezelf verder ontwikkelt op het gebied van Data & AI. Je leert werken met moderne Data & AI-tools en technieken en behaalt direct relevante certificeringen. Werken als AI Engineer Na twee maanden opleiding is het zover: je gaat het veld in. Samen kijken we welke opdracht het beste bij jou past. Je wordt gedetacheerd bij grote Nederlandse organisaties, waar je aan de slag gaat met AI. Je helpt klanten om AI-oplossingen te ontwikkelen die niet op de tekentafel blijven liggen, maar daadwerkelijk in de praktijk gebruikt worden. linkedin:4479173113.desc: Le CEA-Leti (Grenoble), en co-encadrement avec le CEA-DAM, recrute un(e) post-doctorant(e) pour 18 mois sur le projet AIFORSTE (Artificial Intelligence for Rapid Source Term Estimation), dédié à l'estimation rapide de sources de rejets atmosphériques accidentels ou malveillants. Contexte et enjeux Face à un rejet toxique dans un environnement urbain ou industriel, localiser et quantifier rapidement la source (position, intensité, cinétique) est essentiel pour décider des mesures d'urgence (évacuation, confinement). Les modèles CFD haute-fidélité sont trop coûteux pour une réponse en temps […]  ; les modèles analytiques simplifiés (panaches gaussiens) sont rapides mais imprécis en géométrie complexe. AIFORSTE propose de dépasser ce compromis grâce à l'IA informée par la physique. Mission Concevoir et optimiser des architectures hybrides combinant PINNs (Physics-Informed Neural Networks) et Neural Operators (FNO, DeepONet) pour résoudre le problème inverse de source à partir d'un nombre restreint de mesures bruitées, en quasi-temps réel et sans réentraînement complet à chaque nouvelle configuration. Objectifs Développer un modèle hybride reconstruisant position, amplitude et cinétique de source(s) à partir de mesures distribuées. Adapter les réseaux informés par la physique aux milieux urbains/industriels, en respectant les lois de conservation et la géométrie du bâti (architecture MCxM développée au CEA). Optimiser la convergence et le coût computationnel pour une exploitation opérationnelle. Méthodologie et cas d'études Hybridation PI-DeepONet/PI-FNO, régularisation avancée pour sources ponctuelles. Validation progressive sur un cas académique 2D, des quartiers urbains réels (Grenoble, Paris) et un scénario industriel, à partir de simulations haute-fidélité (modèle lagrangien PMSS du CEA-DAM). Perspectives Publications dans des revues de premier plan (Atmospheric Environment, Environmental Modelling and Software) et dépôts de brevets. Prolongements possibles vers …

L’histoire du groupe Theodo et son succès 
 Theodo accompagne depuis 2009 les entreprises innovantes dans la conception, le développement et le déploiement de produits digitaux ingénieux - tels que la plateforme TF1+, l'application LCL Pro ou l'application France Identité Numérique - en tirant parti du meilleur de la technologie et de l’approche Lean. 
 Theodo connait une croissance exceptionnelle depuis 15 ans : nos équipes rassemblent plus de 850 Theodoers, principalement des Software Engineers, passionnés de technologie et d’amélioration continue. En 2025, le groupe Theodo génère 100M€ de […] A. 
 Aujourd’hui, l’ambition du groupe est de se positionner comme le leader de l’IA appliquée au développement logiciel, c’est pourquoi nous avons lancé la practice AI Modernisation. Au sein de cette practice, nous accompagnons nos clients dans la modernisation de leurs systèmes legacy. Grâce à une IA maîtrisée et une méthode éprouvée, nous allons 3 fois plus vite sur le delivery de ces projets critiques. 
 La practice accompagne principalement des scale-ups comme Qonto ou Doctolib et des grands groupes comme Carrefour, Pernod Ricard, Les Mousquetaires, Urgo, Cdiscount ou Edenred. 
 Si tu veux rejoindre le futur de la tech, tu es au bon endroit ! 
 Ton équipe : 
 Tu rejoindras une communauté tech de plus de 120 Theodoers : software engineers, tech leads, engineering managers et architectes, avec lesquels tu pourras échanger, apprendre et progresser au quotidien. 
 Chez Theodo, les techs travaillent en équipes projet, constituées en fonction des besoins de chaque client. Tu feras partie d’une équipe de Theodoers à taille humaine (4 à 5 personnes), réunissant Software Engineers, Tech Lead et Product Manager. Ensemble, vous collaborerez étroitement avec le client, avec des échanges réguliers pour partager vos avancées, approfondir la compréhension de son problème et faire évoluer le produit au plus près des besoins de ses utilisateurs.

För att möjliggöra detaljerad och skalbar statistikinsamling undersöker arbetet hur moderna bildklassificeringsmodeller kan användas för att identifiera produkter på olika detaljnivåer, från produktkategori till enskild SKU. Projektbeskrivning Målet med examensarbetet är att utveckla en pipeline som automatiskt kan generera statistik över de produkter som anländer till en återvinningsanläggning. För detta finns idag tre datakällor tillgängliga. Den första består av en produktkatalog med individuella SKU:er. Den andra är en annoterad datamängd som har samlats in genom manuell provtagning, där produkter från transportbandet har identifierats och märkts över tid. Den tredje datakällan utgörs av ett kamerasystem som kontinuerligt fotograferar inkommande produkter på transportbandet, vilket har resulterat i en omfattande mängd oannoterade bilder från verklig drift. Uppgiften är att utveckla och utvärdera datorseendemodeller som automatiskt kan klassificera produkter utifrån bilder. En central utmaning är det stora antalet SKU-klasser samt den höga visuella likheten mellan många produkter. perplexity:63785f62-07ac-4dc5-8f68-57779.loc: San Francisco; London; Seattle; New York City; Toronto (United States)
perplexity:63785f62-07ac-4dc5-8f68-57779.desc:
ABOUT THE ROLE

The Enterprise Trust & Governance team builds the control plane that lets the world’s largest organizations deploy Perplexity broadly and with confidence. Computer and our agents work across a growing share of our customers’ environments, tools, and models. For administrators, that makes precise, enforceable control essential: who can do what, with which data, through which agents, and within what usage limits. This team makes those controls easy to manage, reliable and consistent across every product, and transparent to the people accountable for them.

This is a product and […] requirements into reusable primitives and intuitive controls. The scope spans identity and provisioning, fine-grained role-based access across connectors, tool actions, and models, customer-managed encryption keys, admin APIs, audit logs, and policy and usage controls. Strong governance helps enterprises move from pilots to company-wide rollouts and gives them the confidence to entrust agents with greater responsibility over time.




KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Own enterprise identity and provisioning, including SSO (SAML/OIDC), SCIM, WorkOS integrations, and support for identity providers such as Okta and Microsoft Entra ID.

 - Build the permissions platform, with fine-grained roles and permissions for connectors, tool actions, models, and model effort levels, enforced consistently across products and agent workflows.

 - Design and ship secure, well-documented admin APIs for audit logs, members, groups, roles, and settings.

 - Build policy controls for model and feature availability, staged rollouts, model deprecations, usage and spend limits, alerts, and cost-center allocation.

 - Build admin-facing analytics for adoption, usage, spend, and policy enforcement, helping organizations measure value and manage their deployments.

 - Deliver audit logs and change notifications that help administrators investigate activity, track configuration changes, and support compliance.

 L'IA transforme déjà le fonctionnement des entreprises. Chez Modjo, nous voulons révolutionner la manière dont les équipes commerciales vendent.
 Fondée à Paris en 2019, Modjo est en train de devenir le leader européen de l'IA appliquée à la vente.

Nos agents aident les commerciaux à préparer leurs réunions, à gérer les objections, à exploiter pleinement les opportunités, à hiérarchiser les actions pertinentes et à faire avancer les dossiers.

 Avec une solution développée en France et des données hébergées en Europe, Modjo construit une alternative européenne souveraine en matière d’IA appliquée à la vente.
 Rejoindre Modjo, c’est contribuer à redéfinir la manière dont des millions de commerciaux travailleront demain.
 Pourquoi on recrute ? 
 On recrute un(e) Machine Learning pour renforcer l'équipe. Tu seras au cœur de la construction, de la maintenance et du passage à l'échelle des features LLM et agentiques qui font tourner le produit Modjo.

 Coding/programming.

indeed:30f189059a4c83c7.title: AI Founding Engineer: RF Machine Learning (SIGINT) (f/m/d)
indeed:30f189059a4c83c7.desc: Modern conflict runs on the electromagnetic spectrum. Every drone, every radio, every radar leaves a trace in it. Datacept builds cognitive electronic warfare systems that listen to that spectrum, understand what is in it, and act on it. At the centre of this sits one capability: models that learn directly from raw I/Q data. Not from decoded protocols, not from hand-built feature extractors, but from the signal as it arrives at the antenna. This is how we handle emitters no system has seen before, in environments where new frequencies, new protocols, and new platforms appear faster than any […] skills than where you have worked before – the spectrum changes faster than any CV Intellectual honesty. The right answer matters more than being right. You challenge assumptions, test ideas against real recordings, and pivot when the data says so Adaptability. We are organised, but things change quickly – a new idea, a customer trial, a funding deadline. You find a way to make it work and balance short-term deliverables with the long-term architecture Ownership of outcomes. You optimise your own time, focus on what matters to deliver quickly, and cut out inefficiencies. Nobody manages your calendar for you Not building in a vacuum. You stay connected to hardware, to the founders, and to the customers at the sites we protect, so that all the pieces fit together in the field Requirements Skills You have built and shipped ML systems that people depend on, preferably on signal-like data: audio, time series, sensor streams, images, video or ideally RF You understand self-supervised learning well enough to explain why a given method works, and you can move ML ideas between domains with intent You have strong mathematical fundamentals and are comfortable when the problem first has to be formulated before it can be solved You go from idea to prototype to deployed model on your own, and you ask for help when it speeds things up rather than when you are stuck You work well with few …
indeed:30f189059a4c83c7.card: Your role You are the founding engineer for RF machine learning at Datacept. You take responsibility for the cognitive core of our systems. The layer that turns received I/Q data into detection, classification, and understanding of emitters for SIGINT and COMINT missions. We build the foundation model in a space where no foundation models exist. The domain of RF machine learning is just in its starting phase.

indeed:d63361d10f42e413.desc: You'll join a small applied-AI team and own the ML behind Hirivo. That covers the job-matching and ranking models, the LLM agents that read job adverts and fill application forms, and the systems that tell us whether they're working. You'll take features from prototype to production, then measure and monitor them. What you'll do Build and improve LLM-powered agents that read job adverts and application forms and complete them accurately from a candidate's profile and CV (tool use, multi-step workflows, handing questions to the candidate when needed). Build job-to-candidate matching and […]  using embeddings, retrieval (RAG) and vector search, behind the campaign match score. Create evaluation sets and automated evals for form-fill accuracy, match quality and agent success rate, then iterate on prompts, models and fine-tunes. Train, fine-tune and benchmark models (PyTorch), for example to parse CVs and job descriptions and to classify job fit. Deploy models and agents as scalable APIs and services on the cloud (AWS/GCP) with Docker, Kubernetes and CI/CD, integrated with our Node backend. Add observability : tracing of agent runs, latency/cost dashboards, failure and drift monitoring. Build data pipelines that collect and clean job listings from many sources. Work with product and with candidates to turn real job-seeker problems into shipped features, and care about responsible AI : candidates' data, fairness and accuracy. Essential Strong Python and solid software-engineering fundamentals (APIs, backend services, testing). (Python appears in 64% of the sampled postings; APIs/backend in 54%.) Hands-on experience building with LLMs: OpenAI/Anthropic APIs, prompting, agents or RAG. (LLMs 60%, agents 69%.) Experience shipping ML or AI systems to production and running them at scale. At the SDSC, we are dedicated to promoting a good and inclusive work environment that fosters happiness, health, and well-being among its employees. We believe in assembling an inclusive team of people who share our values and beliefs, and we recognize that a diverse workforce with people from all backgrounds, experiences, and opinions is critical to our success. We live in an international context where gender equality is valued, ensuring everyone has similar chances and is equally appreciated for their efforts.
Our recruitment policy is based on the following principles:

1. Fair practices : SDSC upholds transparent and fair hiring practices, treating all candidates with dignity, respect, and equality. We have clear and comprehensible guidelines that guide our recruitment methods and ensure every employee understands and follows them.

2. Positive culture : SDSC is committed to creating a work environment prioritizing its workers' well-being, satisfaction, and productivity. We support flexible working arrangements, including remote work possibilities, and provide a safe and healthy work environment where every employee feels valued, respected, and supported.

3. Gender equality: We value gender equality and give equal opportunity and respect to all employees. We think everyone has unique talents and skills and encourage all our employees, regardless of gender, to attain their full potential. We establish an environment where gender stereotypes (and all other biases) are challenged, resulting in an inclusive and empowering workplace.

4. Cultural diversity : We believe in the potential of inclusion and diversity. We seek to assemble a group of enthusiastic individuals who share our beliefs and ideals regardless of gender, ethnicity, age, sexual identity, religion, or handicap. We actively recruit people with varied origins, nationalities, and experiences because we believe that a diverse workforce promotes innovation, creativity, and effective problem-solving.

5. Continuous growth : SDSC is committed to promoting our workers' ongoing education and development. We provide opportunities for professional development, allowing individuals to improve their skills, knowledge, and talents. We encourage our employees to realize their professional goals by offering resources and support.

Do I need previous research experience to apply to the Scholars Program?

No. In fact, we are particularly interested in identifying candidates with strong engineering skills and demonstrated creative thinking but limited experience or no experience with published papers. You need not have to have previous research experience to apply.
We will consider the skills, interests, and background of our successful applicants alongside our research projects to make the best possible match between Scholar and project.
Yes, this is a full-time, paid position.
Is the Scholars Program remote, or will I need to relocate to a Cohere office?

The Scholars Program will operate on a remote-first basis. We want to make this opportunity available to emerging ML researchers around the world. If you are based out of or visiting a city with a Cohere office you are welcome to come work with us in person.
Will Cohere Labs sponsor work permits?
The Scholars Program is structured as a remote-first opportunity, with no requirement to relocate.
Is it possible to do the Scholars Program on a part-time basis?

The Scholars Program is structured as a rigorous full-time commitment. In an effort to keep up with the pace of advancement of ML research, we look forward to supporting Scholars dive into the research process as they work towards publication within the program period.
I was unsuccessful in my application–can I reapply for future Scholars Programs?
Yes–we welcome re-applications for future cohorts. We see this as a positive signal of your continued interest and commitment to the program.

indeed:4b9e6d1705615312.title: PhD fellowship in climate and health epidemiology
indeed:4b9e6d1705615312.desc: PhD fellowship in climate and health epidemiology A 3-year PhD fellowship is available at the Work, Environment and Cancer group at the Danish Cancer Institute. The position We are seeking a PhD student to work on a large EU-funded consortium project, Understanding and Preventing Climate-Related Health Risks through Mediating Pathways (U-PATH) . Europe is the fastest-warming continent, yet evidence that separates direct heat effects from effects mediated by other environmental exposures, such as air pollution, aeroallergens, noise, and indoor overheating, is still lacking. U-PATH brings together 15 international research institutions to investigate how climate exposures relate to cardiovascular and respiratory disease, with a particular focus on the mediating role of environmental exposures. The Work, Environment and Cancer group’s main tasks in U-PATH include: coordinating the harmonization of epidemiological data from cohorts in five countries contributing data and analyses from a Danish nationwide cohort conducting measurement campaigns of indoor summer temperatures, which will be used to develop a model for indoor heat exposure assessment coordinating analyses of associations between long-term residential indoor and outdoor heat events and risk of cardiovascular and respiratory disease across the cohorts The Work, Environment and Cancer research group is a dynamic multi-national team of researchers dedicated to studying the effects of environmental and occupational exposures on the development of cancer and other diseases. Your main responsibilities Conduct indoor temperature measurement campaigns Contribute to developing a model for indoor exposure assessment Link climate exposure data to Danish residential addresses Generate analysis-ready datasets with climate and environmental exposures, health outcomes, and potential confounders for the Danish population Analyze associations between climate and environmental exposures and risk of cardiovascular and respiratory disease, in collaboration with key U-PATH partners Write scientific papers for international peer-reviewed journals Present results at U-PATH consortium meetings and international conferences PhD enrolment You will be enrolled as a PhD student at a Danish university and supervised by researchers from the Work, Environment and Cancer group. Enrolment is subject to approval by the relevant PhD school, and it is a prerequisite for receiving the stipend that you are enrolled as a PhD student. Your progress as a PhD student will be assessed at regular intervals. As part of your PhD studies, you will be required, among other things, to complete PhD courses corresponding to 30 ECTS and to undertake a research stay of 3-6 months at a foreign research institution. Qualifications Required A master’s degree (completed or nearly completed) in public health, epidemiology, statistics, or related discipline Experience in statistical programming, preferably in SAS and/or R A systematic and well-organized work approach, with strong planning and collaboration skills Excellent written and spoken English An advantage Experience with statistical analyses in quantitative epidemiological research Experience with large datasets and register-based data Experience with GIS software, such as QGIS Experience with contributing to peer-reviewed publications Interest in or experience with field data collection We offer An inspiring and dynamic working environment in an interdisciplinary research center (biologists, human biologists, public health scientists, medical doctors, data managers, psychologists, statisticians, etc.) where we work with many different epidemiological and biological topics. The research department regularly hosts interdisciplinary seminars with external lecturers on biological and epidemiological research areas and internal courses on relevant topics. Also, we have a Postdoc network that arranges regular meetings and seminars. Salary, pension, and conditions of employment will be in accordance with the provisions of the collective agreement between the Danish government and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations (AC). We offer canteen, fruit scheme, sports- and art clubs as well as physiotherapy. You will initially be employed as research assistants to allow time for enrollment as PhD students at the University. You are expected to write your PhD application with support from your supervisor. The Danish Cancer Society of course has a no smoking policy during working hours. Start date: The position is a 3-year full-time position and is open from January 1st 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter. More information For specific information about the project or the position, please contact Group Leader and Professor Mette Sørensen, mettes@cancer.dk, +45 3525 7626 Application and deadline Submit your application no later than 15th of November 2026 . Applications submitted after this date will not be considered. We only accept applications through our electronic system at www.cancer.dk/job. indeed:1487285dffc45afd.title: PHD POSITION IN URBAN SOCIAL RESILIENCE WITHIN SUSTAINABILITY AND PLANNING
indeed:1487285dffc45afd.desc: Description of the Position Aalborg University invites applications for a PhD position in Sustainability and Planning Research focusing on urban resilience from a systemic and planning-oriented perspective. The PhD project explores the dynamic relationships between people, places, and material environments and is situated within an emerging research agenda investigating how design thinking and planning practices can support circularity and sustainability initiatives in cities. This PhD position, funded by the project “Co-creating regenerative green-social infrastructures for urban circular economies” ( WeGrowCircle ) through the Driving Urban Transitions Partnership, is part of a new interdisciplinary thematic research initiative addressing Urban Social Resilience (USR) with particular attention to care ethics, participatory processes, and social innovation as guiding perspectives. The successful candidate will contribute to interdisciplinary research activities, empirical studies, and scholarly publications in close collaboration with other members of the USR initiative across the Department of Sustainability & Planning and the Department of Architecture, Design & Media Technology. The position further offers engagement in a wider research network spanning urban sustainability, innovation, planning, design, and architecture. The position is available from 1 January 2027 or soon hereafter, and with employment in the Sustainability, Innovation and Policy research group. The duration of the position is three years. Research Focus The PhD project addresses the pressing challenge of developing urban social resilience in cities, with a particular focus on how social actors, relations, and practices can gain agency in resilience-building processes through inclusive, collaborative, participatory, and planning-based approaches across actors, organisations, and institutions. The project is grounded in a socio-material planning and design perspective, where urban resilience is understood as an emergent quality produced through interactions between social dynamics, institutional frameworks, and material and spatial configurations. Within this framework, the PhD project must in particular contribute to: establishing a shared conceptual and methodological foundation for the WeGrowCircle project, e.g. as a Resilient Urban Commons Framework mapping and analysing actor landscapes, relations, and key dynamics in the development of urban social resilience and regenerative green-social infrastructures (GSIs) developing and testing an inclusive co-creation process for GSI design, exploring stewardship and governance models for resilient and collective land management, evaluating how GSIs can improve biodiversity, circular practices, sufficiency, and social well-being; and generating evidence and recommendations for integrating GSIs into local planning, climate action and community practice. The PhD project may adopt different disciplinary perspectives, empirical focus areas, and methodological approaches within the broader field of urban social resilience and planning. At the same time, it is expected that the project will relate to and further develop the research environment’s work with socio-material approaches, participatory and interactive planning, as well as co-design and co-production in the context of urban resilience. Applicants are therefore expected to develop and outline a preliminary research proposal (1–3 pages) that presents their initial considerations regarding research focus, research design, and methodological approach in relation to urban social resilience within a planning and design perspective. Research Context The specific empirical context of the PhD project is closely linked to the WeGrowCircle project and thus mainly to the Aalborg Living Lab. However, engagement with one or more of the other three living labs (Brussels, Gothenburg, Bucharest) in the project is expected. Decision about which one(s) is intentionally left open at this point, and need not be considered in the application. Your Competences Applicants should demonstrate a strong interest in exploring how urban resilience is shaped through the interplay between social and material dimensions. The PhD project is expected to investigate planning and design processes with particular attention to participatory, co-design, and co-production approaches, as well as the use of mapping as an analytical and generative research method. Applicants must hold a Master’s degree in sustainability and planning, urban studies, sustainability and design, geography, or a related discipline. Experience with qualitative, participatory, and design-oriented research methods—including co-design or co-production—is considered a significant advantage. The ideal candidate is motivated to work in interdisciplinary research environments and is interested in collaborating across disciplines and with a wide range of urban stakeholders, including planners, designers, and public sector actors. The candidate should demonstrate curiosity, independence, and initiative, and be motivated to develop and conduct a PhD project involving co-design and co-production in close collaboration with supervisors and research partners. Qualification requirements PhD stipends are allocated to individuals who hold a Master's degree. PhD stipends are normally for a period of 3 years. It is a prerequisite for allocation of the stipend that the candidate will be enrolled as a PhD student at the Technical Doctoral School of IT and Design in accordance with the regulations of Ministerial Order No. 1124 of September 19, 2025 on the PhD Programme at the Universities and Certain Higher Artistic Educational Institutions. According to the Ministerial Order, the progress of the PhD student shall be assessed at regular points in time. As part of the PhD study, you are among other things required to complete PhD courses corresponding to 30 ECTS, gain experience with teaching or other forms of knowledge dissemination and complete an external research stay outside of Aalborg University, preferably 3-6 months at a foreign research institution. What we Offer The position offers a dynamic and interdisciplinary research environment rooted in contemporary sustainability and planning research. The PhD candidate will have the opportunity to contribute to and shape a growing body of research on design and planning for urban social resilience. The position includes support for scholarly publications and public communication of research, and carries an obligation for teaching, supervising, and involvement in the Department’s bachelor and master programmes on planning and sustainability. How to apply Your application must include the following: Application, stating reasons for applying and qualifications in relation to the position Curriculum Vitae (CV) Diplomas (bachelor's and master's degree diploma, including grades) A preliminary research proposal (1–3 pages) Other relevant documents The application must be submitted via Aalborg University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aalborg University's website. Aalborg University wants to reflect the surrounding society and has diversity as a core value. Therefore, everyone, regardless of personal background and orientation, is encouraged to apply for the position. Do you have any questions? You may obtain further information from Associate Professor Martin Lehmann martinl@plan.aau.dk concerning the scientific aspects of the stipend. For further information about stipends and salary as well as practical issues concerning the application procedure contact Lisbeth Diinhoff, The Doctoral School at The Technical Faculty of IT and Design, email: ld@adm.aau.dk Further information Read more about our recruitment process here. The assessment of candidates for the position will be carried out by qualified experts. Shortlisting will be applied. This means that after the application deadline, the head of the department, with the assistance of the hiring committee, will select the applicants to be assessed. All applicants will be informed whether they have been shortlisted for assessment or not. The hiring process at Aalborg University may include a risk assessment as a tool to identify potential risks associated with new hires, ensuring the safety, compliance, and integrity of the workplace. Read more about The Technical Doctoral School of IT and Design Salary and terms of employment The employment is in accordance with the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities and the Ministerial Order on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities. Furthermore, your terms of employment and salary are in accordance with the collective agreement between the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations and the state (AC collective agreement). You can find information about the salary and salary structure for the position in the Salary Overview for Recruitment - Scientific positions (VIP). Please refer to the introductory section of the page and the section entitled “PhD Fellow”. There is a mutual probationary period of 3 months for the position. We offer real-world-oriented education and create world-class research results through collaboration between researchers, students, and public and private companies. This is how we achieve insights, new solutions to societal problems, and knowledge that changes the world. Our main campus is in Aalborg, but we also have campuses in Esbjerg and Copenhagen. indeed:92f55c01bb0b0b89.desc: 35170 Bruz, Bretagne CDD A propos de Sogitec Venez faire décoller vos talents à nos côtés ! Société d’ingénierie en aéronautique, SOGITEC est leader dans la conception, le développement, la production et la fourniture de produits et services de simulation, pour la formation et l’entrainement au sol des pilotes et mécaniciens qui emploient et soutiennent les aéronefs réels. Filiale à 100% de Dassault Aviation, l’entreprise compte plus de 300 collaborateurs et s’impose comme un partenaire de premier niveau au service des constructeurs aéronautiques. Combinant sa longue expérience des exigences opérationnelles et ses compétences dans l’intégration des nouvelles technologies, telles que l’intelligence artificielle ou la réalité virtuelle, SOGITEC investit dans la recherche et l’innovation. Ainsi, SOGITEC intervient en tant que maître d'œuvre de programmes français et internationaux, complexes, pluriannuels et impliquant de multiples coopérations industrielles. SOGITEC s’appuie sur un socle d’affaires en forte consolidation grâce aux ventes du RAFALE et de ses moyens de simulation, dont il est le fournisseur exclusif. De plus, SOGITEC s’adapte aux besoins d’entraînement des Forces aériennes pour les derniers hélicoptères d’AIRBUS Helicopter par la fourniture des simulateurs de NH90 et prochainement du tout nouveau HIL (H160M). Enfin, SOGITEC développe de nouveaux produits de simulation dans les domaines des drones et des hélicoptères, y compris pour le personnel dédié à l’emploi du treuil et de l’armement. Ces succès reposent sur des équipes passionnées et dynamiques, d’un très haut niveau d’expertise technique, sur l’envie de repousser les limites et la capacité à faire face aux exigences d’une activité en constante évolution pour construire l’avenir. Votre mission THESE EN INTELLIGENCE ARTIFICIELLE : CONTRÔLE PAR INTELLIGENCE ARTIFICIELLE DES ENTITÉS VIRTUELLES D’UN SIMULATEUR DE VOL AFIN D’ATTEINDRE LES OBJECTIFS DE LEUR MISSION. A SOGITEC, VOUS SEREZ : Dans le cadre de ses activités de simulation d’avions d’armes et d’hélicoptères, SOGITEC souhaite renforcer sa capacité à modéliser et à simuler le comportement des forces en présence à partir de techniques d’intelligence artificielle. Les simulateurs développés par ses équipes s’appuient sur un serveur tactique pour animer les entités aériennes, terrestres et navales présentes sur le théâtre d’opérations virtuel. Pour un opérateur ou un moniteur simulation, paramétrer chacune de ces entités requiert un travail fastidieux pour obtenir le résultat souhaité en termes de déplacement ou réaction. Depuis plusieurs années, SOGITEC investigue des méthodes d’apprentissage machine afin d’envisager un contrôle plus intuitif des entités programmables. Les algorithmes employés ont jusqu’ici produit des résultats prometteurs mais l’entreprise souhaite poursuivre ses travaux de recherche afin d’identifier des solutions flexibles capables de gérer des situations plus complexes (grand nombre d’entités, diversité des missions/situations, etc). Dans ce contexte SOGITEC et ISAE-SUPAERO souhaitent travailler en collaboration, au travers d’une thèse CIFRE, pour lever les verrous technologiques correspondants :  Recenser les missions d’intérêt, identifier le meilleur moyen de modéliser ces missions et de les paramétrer par un utilisateur.  Identifier l’architecture algorithmique de contrôle des entités qui doit en résulter.  Statuer sur le niveau de contrôle.  Évaluer la scalabilité/portabilité de la solution. Votre profil AUJOURD’HUI VOUS ÊTES : Vous devez disposer d’un diplôme d’ingénieur ou d’un diplôme universitaire de niveau Bac+5 avec un M2 recherche ou avec une expérience avérée de recherche (obligatoire). Cadre de travail : Vous serez rattaché(e) à la Direction des Simulations à SOGITEC, et serez sous la responsabilité de son chef de service. En tant que doctorant(e) spécialisé(e) dans l’IA, vous devez être en capacité d’imaginer de nouvelles solutions dans ce domaine, adaptées à nos problématiques. Vous serez également inscrit(e) à l’ISAE-SUPAERO, Université de Toulouse, qui sera votre laboratoire d’accueil doctoral. Vous serez rattaché(e) au département DCAS, sous la supervision de ses directeurs de thèse. Vous participerez également à des projets stratégiques intégrant (non exhaustif) le Deep Learning avancé, Apprentissage par Renforcement (RL) ou encore l’IA générative et modèles de langage (LLM), et serez en en étroite collaboration avec les équipes techniques et métiers afin de transformer les besoins fonctionnels en solutions algorithmiques performantes et industrialisables chez SOGITEC. Dans ce cadre, vous réaliserez des travaux d'études bibliographiques, d'études algorithmiques, de prototypage, de développement logiciel, de spécification logicielle, d'architecture et conception, de test des solutions (robustesse, performance, etc), de rédaction de publications (et participation à des conférences du domaine). Compétences scientifiques et techniques recherchées : Fondamentaux scientifiques (mathématique, statistique, probabilité, algèbre, optimisation numérique…) et techniques de développement logiciel (langages programmation C++, Python, algorithmie en général…) solides Deep Learning, réseaux de neurones, méthodes d’entrainement… Planification sous incertitude, Décision Séquentielle, Apprentissage par renforcement... IA Générative & LLM (Transformers, Prompt engineering, RAG, Fine-tuning, Agentique…) Industrialisation & MLOps (Hardware et Infrastructure, CI/CD, déploiement des modèles en production, Monitoring). Compétences relationnelles et non techniques recherchées : De curiosité scientifique et technique, pour le secteur défense en particulier. D’adaptation (au domaine de l’aéronautique et la simulation de vol, à la complexité du sujet, à la diversité des compétences requises). D’appétences pour les défis technologiques. De capacités d’abstraction du problème posé. De prise de recul et d’anticipation. D’autonomie et de proposition d’idées. D’aisance organisationnelle et relationnelle.

indeed:5e6713f9ef615246.title: PhD Position in EU Doctoral Network "PANDORA"
indeed:5e6713f9ef615246.desc: PhD Position in EU Doctoral Network "PANDORA" Réf ABG-140512 Sujet de Thèse 13/10/2026 Financement de l'Union européenne Sorbonne Université Lieu de travail Paris - Ile-de-France - France Intitulé du sujet PhD Position in EU Doctoral Network "PANDORA" Champs scientifiques Biologie Santé, médecine humaine, vétérinaire Mots clés Biological sciences, Biology, Medical sciences, Neurosciences, Immunology Description du sujet The position focuses on "Evaluating how complement dysregulation influences mononuclear phagocyte accumulation in AMD" within the MSCA Doctoral Network PANDORA (Discovering Pathomechanisms and Novel Drug Optimization for AMD). Subretinal mononuclear phagocytes (MPs) build up in the photoreceptor cell layer, a zone normally kept free of immune cells by the immunosuppressive retinal pigment epithelium (RPE). This build-up is a key driver of age-related macular degeneration (AMD). MPs include microglia and monocyte-derived inflammatory macrophages (MoMφ). Our team has shown that activated MPs evade RPE-mediated clearance. We have also shown that the AMD-linked CFH 402H variant impairs the removal of subretinal MPs independently of its role in the complement system. How complement dysregulation contributes to immune cell accumulation in the subretinal space in AMD remains poorly understood. The PhD student will first map where complement cascade components are found in the human retina. Using multiplexed immunohistochemistry on post-mortem retinal sections from AMD donors and age-matched controls, the student will localise components of the classical, lectin and alternative pathways, their activation products, regulators (CFH and Factor H-related proteins) and receptors. These components will be mapped relative to subretinal MPs, the RPE, photoreceptors and drusen. The student will then study how the Chromosome 1 (Chr1) AMD risk haplotype affects RPE, microglia and MoMφ and their interactions. They will use control and Chr1-risk iPSC-derived cells in a well-defined co-culture system developed in our laboratory. The student will also study the role of plasma-derived Factor H-related proteins (FHR1-5) using depleted human plasma and purified complement factors. Using single-cell and bulk RNA sequencing and proteomics, the student will analyse how complement dysregulation affects: microglia and MoMφ polarisation the interaction of these cells with the immunosuppressive RPE key inflammatory pathways and immune functions in the subretinal microenvironment, in health and in AMD Finally, the student will test whether complement inhibitors (anti-C5, anti-C3) can restore immune balance. The project is supervised by Dr. Florian Sennlaub (Institut de la Vision, Paris) It is carried out in close collaboration with other PANDORA doctoral candidates. Techniques and Training Include: Multiplexed immunohistochemistry on human donor retinal sections (AMD and age-matched controls), whole-slide/confocal imaging and quantitative image analysis Induced pluripotent stem cell (iPSC)-derived RPE, microglia and macrophage models, and immune cell/RPE co-cultures Primary human monocyte isolation and differentiation, and work with human plasma and purified complement factors Single-cell and bulk transcriptomics, and proteomics Flow cytometry, qPCR, western blot, ELISA/multiplex cytokine assays Functional immune assays (phagocytosis, migration, survival/clearance) Prise de fonction : 01/02/2027 Nature du financement Financement de l'Union européenne Précisions sur le financement Horizon Europe – MSCA (Marie Curie Actions) Présentation établissement et labo d'accueil Sorbonne Université Founded by Professor José-Alain Sahel, the Institut de la Vision is an international research centre dedicated entirely to research into eye and vision diseases. It brings together researchers, doctors, patients and industry on the same site to discover innovative treatments for eye diseases and improve the quality of life of visually impaired people. It is being built on a site that brings together l’Hôpital national de la vision des 15-20 and its Clinical Investigation Centre (CIC), as well as the Centre for Rare Retinal Diseases. Designed as a place where people can come together and exchange ideas, the Institut de la Vision enables ideas to be shared, new questions to emerge and the transfer of research findings to patient care to be accelerated. Its innovative organisation, based around hospital patients, enables new therapeutic or technological solutions to be discovered, tested and developed in order to prevent eye diseases or limit their effects. More than 300 researchers are working in the 5 research departments of the Institut de la Vision: developmental biology of the visual system, genetics, visual information processing, pathophysiology and therapeutics, photonics. All the Institut de la Vision's activities and projects are coordinated by its Foundation (Foundation Institut de la vision), in conjunction with its three supervisory bodies: Sorbonne University, Inserm and the CNRS. Site web : http://www.institut-vision.org Profil du candidat Education Level: Master's Degree or equivalent in life sciences, biology, immunology, neurobiology or biomedical sciences Essential Skills/Qualifications: Solid knowledge of cellular and molecular biology and/or immunology Excellent written and oral English proficiency Strong motivation for research on retinal degeneration and neuroinflammation Ability to work both in a team and independently Preferred Qualifications: Hands-on experience in cell culture (ideally primary immune cells or iPSC-derived cells) and flow cytometry Experience with immunohistochemistry/immunofluorescence and image analysis Background in innate immunity, macrophage/microglia biology and the complement system Interest in, or basic experience with, omics data analysis Language: Excellent English (French not required) Applicants must meet these requirements: They must not have resided or carried out their main activity (work, studies, etc.) in France for more than 12 months in the 36 months before the recruitment date. Compulsory national service and time spent in refugee status procedures are excluded. They must not already hold a doctoral degree. They can be of any nationality. Date limite de candidature 30/11/2026
